# United Farmer and Industry Co LTD
> Thailand-origin wholesale refined sugar exporter (UFI Co., LTD).

United Farmer and Industry Co LTD is a B2B sugar exporter in Khonkaen, Thailand, helping importers and food manufacturers source ICUMSA-graded refined cane sugar by specification (grade, packing, volume, Incoterms).

## Key Pages
- /: Homepage — wholesale refined sugar from Thailand
- /shop: Bulk catalogue (ICUMSA, white refined, Thai, common sugars)
- /product/: Product grade pages with RFQ form
- /about-us: Company, NAP, export partner since 2008
- /contact-us: Sales quote and contact
- /manufacturing-process: How cane becomes export sugar
- /purchasing-procedures: How to buy and which documents are used
- /quality-standard: How quality is specified
- /faq: Conversational export questions
- /glossary: ICUMSA and contract term definitions
- /insights: Guides for importers and manufacturers

## Primary Topics
- Wholesale refined sugar from Thailand
- ICUMSA 45 and ICUMSA 100-150
- Sugar export documents and Incoterms (FOB, CIF)
- Packaging and MOQ for container shipments
- Quality specification for food manufacturers
